title: You can see a back three in event data
subtitle: Telling a back three from a back four from where players touch the ball, in seasons the model never saw
note: Balanced accuracy, 95% CI by team. 14,401 segments of 10+ minutes; no team in both training and test. A 'back three' call is right about half the time (back threes are 1 in 5).
caption:
Can you tell a back three from a back four without tracking data, just from where each player touches the ball?

Yes, about 77% of the time, and it held up on seasons I locked away before starting (also 77%).

What it can't do yet: say the minute a team switched.
